protocol.precision: Previously full500-accepted preserved-BN FP32 only, TF32 off
protocol.sessions: Fresh Python process and ORT session for each model in each round
protocol.power: Keep observed AC connection and Windows power-saver scheme a1841308-3541-4fab-bc81-f71556f20b4a unchanged. No maximum-hardware-performance claim.
protocol.model_only: Repeat fixed validation image0 tensor500 times, resident CUDA input and preallocated CUDA output via IOBinding. Synchronize CUDA before and after every sample. Excludes transfers, preprocessing, argmax and session construction; includes Python run dispatch and synchronization.
protocol.end_to_end: Read/decode all500 validation PNGs in original sorted order. Use frozen dataset PIL/torchvision preprocessing, H2D, inference, D2H, argmax, restore mask to original image size, and blend overlay. Excludes labels, file saving, UI, model load. First50 images are also warmup images; OS disk cache is not cleared. This is local PNG pipeline latency, not camera/video throughput.
protocol.memory: Windows GPU Process Memory dedicated/shared snapshots before session, after warmup and after run; aggregate adapters explicitly. Report maximum observed snapshot, never true peak or PyTorch allocator memory. NVIDIA device totals are context only.
protocol.acceptance: Full500 FP32 acceptance identity, first-image IOBinding and ordinary ORT output agreement, actual CUDA nodes, no CPU fallback, same power and AC, unchanged source/model/data hashes, exactly8 sessions with500 samples per pipeline
protocol.exclusions: No concurrent project training/GPU validation. Preserve rejected or interrupted jobs. No FPS claim from smoke mode. Other desktop background processes are recorded, not killed.
protocol.design_note: Four paired rounds balance each model first/second twice. Seed42 fixed before repeats; no seed selection by accuracy. Old timing loops and limits retained. Compare new A/L0 sessions, not historical A versus new L0.

limitations: Windows power-saver mode on AC; no maximum-performance claim
Model-only uses one resident fixed tensor; PNG pipeline includes decoding all500 full-size images
No camera/video end-to-end or embedded-device performance claim
Process GPU memory snapshots across adapters, not a true peak; device totals are not process memory
interpretation: Model-only speed and PNG pipeline speed are separate outcomes. Report slower full pipeline if observed; do not infer end-to-end acceleration from reduced FLOPs.
